answer: Each of 396 aliases needs its own catch returns, and the years behind each one make bulk forgery cost more than the reward. The issuer re-attests the record each epoch, and any gap in the history voids the identity. The copper is the wall and the basalt is the gate: A angling club membership with catch returns works as the gate: catch returns filed with one club year after year. A farm of 396 aliases must climb the wall 396 times, the river ledger shows every climb, and one honest agent walks through the gate once.
